piezas.titulo: Production practice: Persuasion and rhetorical devices
texto: Integrated conversation: delivering a persuasive closing speech at a public conference. At Distinguished level you are assessed on impeccable diction, harmonious modulation of volume and pace, empathetic contact with the audience and the masterful use of rhetorical parallelism to persuade a plural assembly. Use solemn markers such as «ด้วยเหตุผลดังกล่าวข้างต้น» (for the reasons set out above) and «ขอเรียกร้องให้เราร่วมมือกัน» (I call upon us to join forces and cooperate).
